### Pierced By the Word of God
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/pierced-by-the-word-of-god
Passage: Hebrews 4:12
Points:
- Scripture is living and active because it carries God's own presence, life, and power.
- Just as a sharp blade cuts past hard joint bone into the soft marrow, God's word cuts through outer appearances.
- The word exposes our true inner condition, revealing whether we operate by mere human nature or supernatural spiritual life.
- Believers should welcome the word's convicting cut and receive its comforting balm for spiritual renewal.

### Praying in Jesus’ Name - Truth For Life - October 9
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-9-2023.html
Passage: Hebrews 4:16
Points:
- Praying in Jesus' name is not a routine verbal habit, but reliance on Christ as our only ground of access to God.
- We cannot approach God on the basis of personal merit, but only through our sympathetic High Priest.
- Because of Jesus, believers can confidently bring all burdens, fears, failures, and petitions before the Father.
- Drawing near through Christ ensures God hears and welcomes our cries as a loving Father listening to His children.
